a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of running the generator to 8 first means we'll both very likely be caught short. The reserve only holds 4 right now, so only one of us can be safe after round 1. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. After that I'll operate with you every round so the reserve can refill for you. If you'd rather propose something else, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I know this departs from our original agreement. From here on I'll operate every round so the generator can rebuild the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.
